family_name: Autex Grid Ceiling Tiles - Frame - Rectangle - Uncapped

spec.description:
Autex Grid Ceiling Tiles - Frame - Rectangle - Uncapped is a 3D acoustic
ceiling tile designed to drop into standard 1200mm x 600mm suspended grid
systems. Formed from 100% polyester fibre containing a minimum of 60% recycled
PET, the Frame style creates an elegant perimeter-coffer border that defines
each grid module. The uncapped design leaves the top open to the plenum,
allowing ceiling airflow and lighting integration while providing targeted
acoustic absorption (NRC 0.25 - 0.35) and Group 1 fire safety.

install:
Ensure
the suspended 1200mm x 600mm ceiling grid is square, level, and properly
supported

Check that all tiles are supplied from a single production batch to
avoid colour variation

Assemble the Frame tile components according to
manufacturer instructions if supplied flat-packed

Lift the assembled uncapped
Frame tile through the grid opening at an angle

Lower the tile gently onto
the exposed grid flanges, ensuring perimeter notches seat squarely

Where
services or sprinklers occur, maintain required building code clearances
selection_checklist:
Verify ceiling grid module is rectangular
metric 1200mm x 600mm

Confirm uncapped style is desired (leaves plenum
visible from below)
Select desired colour from Autex Cube palette
Calculate pack quantities required for full ceiling or feature zones

Ensure
ceiling grid has adequate load capacity for 3D tiles
accessories: Standard two-way exposed ceiling grid (15mm or 24mm tee)
limitations:
Uncapped configuration does not block
sightlines into the ceiling plenum

Lower NRC compared to capped versions;
specify capped if maximum acoustic absorption is required

Indoor use only;
avoid direct water leaks or wet areas

use_cases:
Replacing standard 1200x600
mineral fibre ceiling tiles in open-plan corporate offices to add depth and
acoustic softening

Creating textured perimeter coffer ceiling features in
university lecture rooms and study spaces

Acoustic and aesthetic ceiling
refurbishment in retail showrooms and reception areas
not_for:
Ceilings
requiring complete visual blockage of the overhead plenum
Wet rooms, showers, or outdoor applications
